# 1.2.107 - The case map: the Investigation panel opens on a Map of the chapter's case, the Table one switch away for each GM; the GM builds deductions, counters and the solution there, on nodes shown whole and edited on themselves, in a map that pans and zooms, checks the case, and realizes the Key Remnant plan with a preview and an undo; every Remnant can name who left it, for the GMs alone

Stages E97 and E98 (`with` E97), one release, as the owner's "Wariant A" of 11.11.2026 asked: the panel changes once.
Its range is v1.2.106 (E76) to the release commit: twenty-five commits with the release commit, two of them merges. Fifteen are on the
E97/E98 branch, a881094c to 1e1c61c9, merged onto 1.2.105 + E76 (60dc0a54) as ae4ec07a; then the schema editor's
named fields (3a288faa), five comments (fa8cf14f), main's 1.2.106 merged in (fa73b601), the E97 fix line after the
owner's review of 12.11.2026 (0db8dca9, db3ef6ac, 1cb13422), the stage ledger's `touches` (656cb513) and scenario 61's D5 check from the gaps
line (d220d7a7). The E99
commits after 1e1c61c9 on that branch are not in this release (1.2.109). In plain words:

- **The Map.** The Investigation panel now opens on a Map of the chapter's case: evidence on the left (Remnants, Key
  Remnant slots, Final Truth Remnants), the deductions and counters in the middle, the solution on the right, and the
  Remnants not tied to the murder below a gap that folds. Every node is as large as its whole name and description,
  and no two overlap. A click or Enter on a node opens its fields on the node itself - a Remnant or a Key slot with the
  Table's own fields, saved by the same **Save** - and Escape or a click on the map's empty space closes them; there is
  no side panel. A line over the map, folded, holds the chapter's counts and problems, **Check consistency**, who has
  what by name and the Final Truth form. Drag empty space to move the map; the wheel zooms about the pointer, and
  **-**, **+** and **Fit to view** (Oddal, Przybliż, Dopasuj do widoku) or the keys +, - and 0 zoom, held between 0.25
  and 2. The old Table is one switch away (**Map** / **Table**, in Polish **Mapa** / **Tabela**), and each GM's choice
  is kept on their own account.
- **The case.** From the row of tools over the Map a GM adds a **deduction**, a **counter**, the **solution** or a
  planned **Incident Remnant**, and orders a column by hand, by kind, by room, by state or with fewer crossings; in a
  node's own fields they set what it rests on (or refutes) and the trial mode it plays out in. Each deduction shows
  "x/y": how many of its inputs students other than the culprit hold, marked once more than half are held (both of
  two, three of four); a Truth Bullet only the culprit holds does not count. **Check consistency** lists what does not
  hold together, as warnings that block nothing.
- **The realization.** **Realization preview** lists each Key Remnant slot not yet on the map and changes nothing;
  **Run realization** places the slots you picked a room for, through the Key planner's own road, and marks each in the
  GMs' case; **Undo realization** removes only what nobody has found and Monokuma has not revealed. When a body is
  found, the primary GM is asked once a chapter whether to open the preview; nothing happens by itself.
- **Who left a Remnant.** New Remnant, Create Key Remnant here, the Final Truth form and the GM's card of a trace now
  have an author select, "Left by (GMs only)", "- unknown -" first. Only GMs see it.

Nothing in this version ran at a real table or on a Foundry server; what was measured was measured headless or in
Chromium through the module's style harness (the module's stylesheets, not Foundry's). Below, an R number names one
of the module's own tests (`game.drpg.runTests()`), and a scenario one of the headless harness's multi-browser runs.
The gaps are in Not in this release, Known gaps and Checked.

## Before installing

- **The Investigation panel opens on the Map** (E97 C9, d83d0700; the owner's "E97 tak" of 12.11.2026). A GM who
  never chose a view opens on the Map; the Table is the switch beside it, and once a GM picks one it is kept for them.
- **The panel has one fixed size** (E97 C2): 1120 px wide instead of as wide as its widest table, the same on the Map,
  with a node open and on every Table tab (the node open read while its fields stood in the side panel, before the E97 fix); a wide table scrolls in its own box, and under Monokuma Legacy the Remnants
  table scrolls sideways there rather than breaking a head inside a word. Measured after C5 (fde1c644, 5b124a4e) in Chromium
  through the style harness, not in Foundry: 1120 x 714 (glass) and 1120 x 688 (Legacy) at 1366x768, 1120 x 1002 and
  976 at 1920x1080 (C2's own reading, e3201025: 710 and 684, 998 and 972);
  before, 1241 px wide at 1366x768. The frame was not measured again after the E97 fix; its sweep read the map's box
  inside it, 972 x 337 (glass) and 972 x 346 (Legacy) at 1366x768, 972 x 641 and 972 x 650 at 1920x1080. On the Map
  that box never scrolls: the wheel over it zooms.
- **The footer is two rows at every width** and has two more buttons, **Realization preview** (Podgląd realizacji)
  and **Undo realization** (Cofnij realizację, with the destructive ones; it asks first). Ten buttons, five a row.
- **Who has what moved** (E98 C4): in the Table view it is a tab of its own after Remnants, Key Remnants and Final
  Truth Remnants (Kto co ma), with the counts table and, under it, each living student's Truth Bullets and items by
  name. Nothing stands above the tabs any more.
- **No world migration.** No setting is renamed and nothing is rewritten at load. A player's traces keep the author
  the module already recorded for them; a Remnant a GM placed before this version names nobody and reads "- unknown -"
  (Polish "- nieznany -"); nothing guesses one.
- **New stored data, all of it the GMs'**:
  - a GM store, the case schema, under the client setting `gmCaseSchema`: per chapter a row for each deduction,
    counter, solution and planned Incident Remnant, and one meta row (its order, the realization's run and its marks,
    when the body's question was asked). It syncs between GMs, any GM writes it (an Assistant GM too), it is in the
    case backup ("The case map: each chapter's deductions, counters and solution"), and a season reset that cuts the
    Key Remnant plan cuts it too (read in gm-stores.mjs, not run);
  - on each GM's own User, the flag `investigationView`, "map" or "table". A User flag reaches every browser, a
    player's included, and this one holds only the word (not a secret, as world-secrets.mjs allows);
  - on a trace's ledger row, `sourceActor` and `sourceName`, which no GM's road could write before (a player's trace
    and a looted body's had them), now written by a GM's author select too; and on a Truth Bullet's answer key in the GMs' store, `leftBy` and
    `leftByName` where its trace names an author, handed on with a copy, never on the item (world-secrets.mjs now
    names `leftBy` in any setting and `leftBy`, `leftByName` on an item).
  - The map's camera (where it is moved and how far it is zoomed) is the open window's own state, kept across its
    redraws and stored nowhere (read in the code, not run).
- **An author a GM sets counts as a player's own** (the owner's Q2): Observe's preference, an incident's tie and the
  killer's clean-up (Tamper) read the same field (read in the code, not run). Naming the killer hands the killer that
  trace to clean. The card asks before it replaces an author.
- **What players can now see**: nothing of the case. The Map, its nodes' fields, the line over it, the realization's
  windows, the question at a body and the GM panel's Incident Remnant line are drawn on a GM only (read in the code;
  the Investigation panel refuses a player as before). What a player can meet is the realization's work: **Run
  realization** puts Key Remnants on the map in the rooms the GM picked, as the Key planner's Place does, and **Undo
  realization** takes off the ones no student has found. That a player's browser holds no author at a real table is
  LIVE-E97-05.
- **The question at a body**: on the primary GM only, after a body is found by either road, once a chapter and only
  when the chapter has a case built and not yet realized (read in the code, case-realize.mjs `shouldAskAtBody`: a
  schema row or a Key slot still to place, and never after a run; neither road of a discovery was driven, Known gaps): "The case's realization", with **Show the preview** (Pokaż podgląd) and
  **Not now** (Nie teraz). Not for the suite's rehearsal body.
- **The GM panel** lists the chapter's planned Incident Remnants under the Next line, "The case waits for N Incident
  Remnants." (Polish "Sprawa czeka na N Incident Remnantów."), each with **Place on the map** (New Remnant filled in)
  or, once placed, **Show**.
- **Glyphs**: the Map's own glyphs (the Map / Table switch, a node's found, on the map and planned marks) are named and
  not drawn yet; the switch, the nodes and the camera's buttons read in words and signs.
- **`module.json`**: unchanged but for the version. No `verified` is raised without a check at a real table.

## Who left a Remnant (E97 C1, a881094c)

- remnants.mjs `setRemnantAuthor` writes `sourceActor` and `sourceName` together on the trace's ledger row, a live row
  only; `authorOptions` draws the select, "- unknown -" first, then every student, living and dead.
  truth-bullets.mjs `leftByOf` names the author in a bullet's answer key; handover.mjs `mintCopy` hands it on. No
  Analyze option (Q1). Red first: R3370, R3371, R3372 at b97028e1 ("no setRemnantAuthor, no leftByOf, no
  authorOptions") and R190 on its three new fixtures. Green at a881094c; tier 2 E60-T8, E60-T9 and the hand-over and
  Final Truth tests green.

## The owner's review: whole nodes, editing on the node, a camera (the E97 fix, 0db8dca9; STATUS-FIX.md db3ef6ac, 1cb13422)

- **Whole content** (R3660). The new case-view.mjs, a leaf with no import: `MAP_GEOMETRY`, `mapPlace` and `edgePath`
  moved there (case-map.mjs re-exports them under the same names). `mapPlace` takes each node's measured size and
  stacks a column, 12 px between nodes, as wide as its widest node, so no two nodes overlap by construction;
  `relayoutCaseMap` measures the drawn nodes in a browser (again when fonts load and when a node's box changes size)
  and places the nodes, the column heads, the gap and the edges again; in jsdom every box reads 0 and the drawn
  numbers stand. A node is at least 240 x 54 (196 wide at C5); its head wraps instead of cutting the kind, so the
  trial-mode pill no longer hides it; its name is whole, and its description stands under it (a Remnant's player text,
  a named Key slot's text, a schema node's note). No line clamp, ellipsis, nowrap or fixed height on any part of a
  node. The two faults seen on the round 1 shots (a trial-mode pill over the kind, slot nodes cutting theirs) went
  with the wrapping head.
- **The node rule now outranks the glass's button rule.** stained-glass.css section 7 (7 classes, `white-space:
  nowrap`, 14 px sides) beat C5's node rule (5 classes), so under the glass every node's name stayed on one line, cut
  at its edge ("The culprit came in wi" in the sweep's first run); the node rule has 8 classes now. The node's state
  rules (hover, held, planned, unrelated, counter, solution) were lighter than the node rule at C5 and reached no node
  in either theme (read in the cascade, not measured); they take its selector now, so by the cascade the node states apply for the first time, and held,
  planned, counter and solution nodes should look other than on the round 1 shots (read from the cascade; no measure of the
  states' look was taken, and the sweep's screenshots, kept outside git, are not cited for it).
- **Editing on the node, no side panel** (R3661). The `<aside>` is gone. Each node's fields are a fieldset under its
  face, 352 px wide open, the open one shown and the rest hidden but still in the form, so the Table's one Save writes
  them as before (the same field names). What the panel said of a node (state, room, author, who has it, mode, reach,
  "only the culprit", its own problems) opens with it; **Move up**, **Move down** and **Remove** are on the node. A
  click or Enter on the face opens it; Escape (stopped there, so the window stays; measured headless, not in Foundry) or a click on the map's empty space
  (a drag is no click) closes it. The chapter's summary - counts, problems, **Check consistency**, who has what, the
  Key limit's override and the Final Truth form - is a folded overview line over the map, and the adds and the column
  order one row of tools over it. The "Rests on" checklist no longer scrolls in a box of its own.
- **The camera** (R3662). The map's box never scrolls (`overflow: clip`); a drag on empty space pans, the wheel zooms
  about the pointer (not over a text box or a picker), and the corner's **-**, **+** and **Fit to view**, or the keys
  +, =, - and 0, zoom; the zoom held to 0.25..2, the pan keeping 48 px of the map in view, and a focused node or field
  and an opened node brought into view. The buttons' and keys' zoom eases 160 ms unless motion is reduced (the
  module's class or the system's); the wheel and a drag never ease. The camera is the window's state, kept across
  redraws.
- **Names.** New EN and PL keys for the new controls (Fields of {name} / Pola: {name}, Map tools / Narzędzia mapy,
  Camera / Kamera, Zoom out / Oddal, Zoom in / Przybliż, Zoom / Przybliżenie, Fit to view / Dopasuj do widoku). The
  order picker is named by its `aria-label` and title, not a visible label, so the tools keep one row at 1366x768
  under the glass. The realization preview's room picker is named by its column and slot: tier 2's named-controls test
  read it nameless at fa73b601 when run with the "E97 C" tests ("24 passed, 1 failed").
- R3651 and R3655 adjusted: R3651 reads a place's x and y (a place carries w and h now), R3655 the open node's problems
  on the node. Probe 08 seeds one long Remnant and a deduction with words. The new audit/case-map-sweep.mjs measures
  the Map in Chromium (Checked).
- Red at fa73b601: `--tier 0 --only R3660 --only R3661 --only R3662 --only R3655 --only R3651`, "2 passed, 4 failed":
  R3660 "there is no case-view.mjs with relayoutCaseMap", R3661 "the open node draws no fields on itself - they stand
  in a side panel: {aside:1,open:null}", R3662 "there is no case-view.mjs with zoomAt", R3655 (its open node's
  problems not on the node). Green, the same five: "6 passed, 0 failed". Planted, each put back: C5's fixed `height:
  54px` read red by R3660, Escape without `stopPropagation` by R3661, the ease kept under reduced motion by R3662.

## Not in this release

- **The realization's descriptions**: the owner's goal had it also add descriptions to existing Remnants, and Undo put
  a description back where it was not changed since (Q5). The realization places Key Remnant slots only; nothing
  writes an existing Remnant's text. A planned Incident Remnant is placed by hand from the GM panel or the Map.
- **The 60-Remnant measurement** (E98's verify): not made, headless or anywhere.
- **The Map's glyphs**: the rows are in tools/glyphs.json and not declared in the generated pixel-icons.css; for the
  coordinator or E48.
- **The scenario work the plan named**: a realization phase in 62-investigation on two GMs, an Assistant's run in
  17-assistant, the schema and its marks in 72-canary's scan, and the joint spec's new scenario 97-case. Only scenario
  62's Table phase changed.
- **The code rules' file table** with the five new files (case-schema.mjs, case-layout.mjs, case-map.mjs,
  case-realize.mjs and the E97 fix's case-view.mjs): for the coordinator.
- **The E99 commits** after 1e1c61c9 (the trial's case schema, ticks, hints and the players' summary): 1.2.109.

## Known gaps

- **Undo leaving what a student found** is read in the code (any student's copy, the dead included, and Monokuma's
  reveal), not run: the tier-2 test's Undo has nothing found (`removed: 1, kept: 0`).
- **The question at a body** is measured by calling the announcement hook as its writer would; neither road of a
  discovery is driven to it headless.
- **Two GMs pressing Run at once**: the 300 ms settle is a choice, not a lock across a slow network (LIVE-E97-04).
- **The camera with a real mouse, trackpad or touch screen**: driven only by synthetic events (R3662 in jsdom, the
  reveal in Chromium); wheel steps, a pinch and a real drag not tried, and no touch device.
- **Escape and Foundry's own Escape**: the keydown is stopped at the map (R3661 reads that nothing outside it heard
  it). Whether Foundry v14's keybinding manager listens in a capturing phase above it was not read from v14's source;
  if it does, Escape would close the window as well.
- **A click elsewhere in the window** (the tools, the footer) leaves an open node open, by choice: Save in the footer
  must not shut the fields it reads.
- **An open deduction is tall**: its "Rests on" lists every other node of the chapter whole, with no inner scroll
  (1019 px under the glass in the sweep, Checked); the camera brings its top into view and the GM
  pans or zooms to the rest.
- **The glass's general button rule** still gives the tools' and the camera's buttons its 14 px sides (not a cut).
- **The handbook's Who has what row** describes the Table's tab, with its counts; who has what by name, in the Map's
  overview, is in the handbook's Map paragraph.
- **61-gmstore-case** read 112/113 once while three scenarios shared four cores (F9, the murder opening's pick kept on
  the primary and re-asked by a second GM), 113/113 alone on the same commit and 113/113 on 0db8dca9's tree (STATUS-FIX.md):
  seen once, not explained. D5's red at 656cb513 is a different check, explained and fixed by d220d7a7 (Checked); F9 is not
